main.description: Bring a context back from the bin, with everything that went with it. Whoever could have deleted it may. One that went along with something else is restored by restoring that.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such context in the bin, or none the caller may restore.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: It went to the bin along with what it is in.

errors.name: PathTaken
errors.description: A live node has since taken its path (HTTP 409).
